The deployment workflow requires a specific structure for the monorepo; the web application resides within the `web/` directory. The trigger for deployment is a push event to the `main` branch, specifically when changes occur within the `web/` directory. This configuration dictates the web deployment workflow.


The web deployment workflow utilizes GitHub Actions, triggered by pushes to the `main` branch with changes in the `web/` directory. It checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies, builds the Vite application, configures GitHub Pages, and then uploads and deploys the `web/dist` directory. The mobile build workflow, however, builds a Flutter mobile application. It triggers on pushes to the 'main' or 'develop' branches with changes in the 'mobile/' directory or modifications to its workflow file.


The mobile build workflow builds both an Android APK and a Flutter web version. Initial setup includes checking out the code, configuring Java and Flutter, and generating the project. After dependency installation and static analysis, the APK is built and uploaded. The Flutter web build step is added and its artifact also uploaded.

args.Content:
"name: Desplegar Fashion Style Web en GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ['main']
    paths:
      - 'web/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-web-pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: 'pages'
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout del código
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configurar Node 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: './web/package-lock.json'

      - name: Instalar dependencias y compilar Vite
        working-directory: ./web
        env:
          VITE_API_BASE_URL: https://fashionstyle.api.adsocidm.com/public/api
          VITE_STORAGE_BASE_URL: https://fashionstyle.api.adsocidm.com/storage
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Configurar GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Subir carpeta dist
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: './web/dist'

      - name: Publicar en GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
"

"name: Build Fashion Style Flutter Mobile

on:
  push:
    branches: ['main', 'develop']
    paths:
      - 'mobile/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-flutter-mobile.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-mobile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./mobile
    steps:
      - name: Checkout del código
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configurar Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Configurar Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Generar plataformas nativas
        run: flutter create . --project-name fashion_style_mobile --org com.fashionstyle

      - name: Instalar dependencias Dart
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Análisis estático de código
        run: flutter analyze

      - name: Compilar APK de Producción (Android)
        run: flutter build apk --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://fashionstyle.api.adsocidm.com/public/api

      - name: Compilar versión Web Móvil de Flutter
        run: flutter build web --release --base-href /FashionStyleDist/mobile/ --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://fashionstyle.api.adsocidm.com/public/api

      - name: Subir APK a Artifacts de GitHub Actions
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fashion-style-mobile-release-apk
          path: mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk

      - name: Subir Flutter Web Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fashion-style-flutter-web
          path: mobile/build/web
"
